critical_code_review_comments: server.py run_callback_reminders: when only_client_id provided AND callback_at != today (server timezone), the query {'id': only_client_id} still matches and the 'not only_client_id and now < target' guard is bypassed, so the reminder is sent immediately regardless of scheduled time. Acceptable for the manual /crm/reminders/run test endpoint (that is the intended shortcut), but document it — a client callback_at=tomorrow would still fire if triggered via API. Consider clarifying in the docstring.

Chip component in QuickCapture: base class contains 'dark:bg-slate-900' while active class contains 'bg-slate-900' — makes DOM-based 'active' detection ambiguous in tests. Adding aria-pressed would help E2E robustness.

onCreated in CRM.jsx: prepends the newly created client to list state, but load() may still be in flight; after delete via sheet the list occasionally shows '0 fiches' until page reload. Consider re-calling load() after create/delete to keep state consistent.
